content.text:
The drawing shows a benzene ring with three substituents in a 1,3,5 pattern: an NH–Alloc group, an OH, and a CO2H.

Alloc is allyloxycarbonyl, C(=O)OCH2CH=CH2, so the NH group becomes NHC(=O)OCC=C.

The molecule is 3-(Alloc-amino)-5-hydroxybenzoic acid.

SMILES: C=CCOC(=O)Nc1cc(O)cc(C(=O)O)c1
